fallback.threat: Enemy strength and intent remain unconfirmed.
fallback.command: Secure the assigned sector and preserve the force for follow-on operations.
fallback.victory: The emergency operation is complete and the sector has returned to Alliance control.
fallback.defeat: The emergency operation failed. Remaining units are withdrawing to the nearest defensible line.

sector-paris.situation: Evacuation trains are loading beyond the western junction while the city grid fails district by district.
sector-paris.threat: Hunter packs are following emergency broadcasts and probing every road that still carries light.
sector-paris.command: Hold the junction, keep the rail approach open, and buy the evacuation column the time it needs.
sector-paris.victory: The last train cleared the perimeter under its own power. The western junction is now our first dependable foothold.
sector-paris.defeat: The junction was overrun before the evacuation cleared. Survivors are scattering along the freight tunnels.

sector-lyon.situation: The industrial quarter still has power, machine tools, and the only intact ammunition presses west of the Rhine.
sector-lyon.threat: Saboteurs are moving through the furnace halls behind screens of smoke and false heat signatures.
sector-lyon.command: Lock down the factory lanes and prevent demolition teams from reaching the working production blocks.
sector-lyon.victory: The presses are running again. Fresh ammunition will reach the field before the next operation cycle.
sector-lyon.defeat: The foundry blocks are burning and the production line is silent. Replacement ammunition will be scarce.

sector-brussels.situation: A buried command archive holds the last coherent picture of the invasion routes across the northern front.
sector-brussels.threat: Enemy scouts have breached the outer offices and are searching for the hardened records vault.
sector-brussels.command: Reach the archive, secure its field drives, and extract before the command block is isolated.
sector-brussels.victory: The archive is in Alliance hands. Its route tables expose a path toward the North Sea ports.
sector-brussels.defeat: The archive went dark during extraction. Northern command must now operate from fragments and dead reckoning.

sector-strasbourg.situation: One serviceable Rhine crossing connects the western depots to every force assembling in the east.
sector-strasbourg.threat: Heavy assault groups are massing behind the river mist while infiltrators mark the bridge piers.
sector-strasbourg.command: Hold both approaches and keep the bridge structure intact for the follow-on columns.
sector-strasbourg.victory: The Rhine crossing is secure. Fuel, armor, and field hospitals can now move into the central front.
sector-strasbourg.defeat: The crossing is lost and the river has split the army. Central formations are rationing fuel and ammunition.

sector-munich.situation: A battered defensive line is holding the southern road network through a second night without relief.
sector-munich.threat: The enemy is using the blackout to shift shock troops between collapsed suburbs and abandoned rail cuts.
sector-munich.command: Reinforce the line, restore its observation posts, and break the next assault before dawn.
sector-munich.victory: The rampart held through sunrise. Central command now has a stable base for the push toward Vienna.
sector-munich.defeat: The defensive belt folded in the dark. Retreating units are abandoning the southern road network.

sector-zurich.situation: Mountain shelters contain reserve power cells, medical stores, and a protected relay beneath the old fortifications.
sector-zurich.threat: Burrowing creatures have opened new passages between the bunkers and turned the tunnel grid into an ambush maze.
sector-zurich.command: Clear the connected shelters and bring the relay back online without collapsing the supply galleries.
sector-zurich.victory: The vault is open and the alpine relay is transmitting. The southern flank can support sustained operations.
sector-zurich.defeat: The tunnel grid is sealed behind the retreat. Stores and relay equipment remain trapped below the mountain.

sector-amsterdam.situation: The harbor cranes and tidal gates can reopen a sea route for heavy equipment that cannot cross the damaged rail net.
sector-amsterdam.threat: Amphibious raiders occupy the quays and are preparing to flood the inner loading basins.
sector-amsterdam.command: Retake the gate controls and clear a protected berth for the first Alliance convoy.
sector-amsterdam.victory: The harbor is working under guard. Heavy cargo is already moving from ship to rail.
sector-amsterdam.defeat: The inner basins flooded before the controls were secured. The northern sea route is closed.

sector-copenhagen.situation: Coastal radar on the strait is the only sensor chain watching the Baltic approach.
sector-copenhagen.threat: Fast aerial and littoral units are converging beneath a storm front to blind the station permanently.
sector-copenhagen.command: Defend the sensor ridge and deny the enemy a corridor around the northern flank.
sector-copenhagen.victory: The North Needle is tracking again. No hostile movement can cross the strait unseen.
sector-copenhagen.defeat: The sensor ridge has gone silent. Northern command is preparing for attacks without warning.

sector-vienna.situation: The inner districts still shelter an organized garrison, but every surface route into the city is closing.
sector-vienna.threat: Siege creatures and corrupted artillery are tightening a ring around the defenders quarter by quarter.
sector-vienna.command: Punch through the siege line and open a resupply corridor before the garrison exhausts its reserves.
sector-vienna.victory: The siege ring is broken. Vienna becomes the forward headquarters for the eastern campaign.
sector-vienna.defeat: The relief column could not reach the inner districts. The surviving garrison is attempting a breakout.

sector-prague.situation: A pulse beneath the old city is repeating on military bands with no transmitter above ground.
sector-prague.threat: The signal bends navigation and draws isolated squads toward a ritual chamber below the street grid.
sector-prague.command: Descend through the service tunnels, locate the source, and sever it before the next pulse.
sector-prague.victory: The underground transmitter is broken. For the first time in weeks, the eastern bands carry only human voices.
sector-prague.defeat: The pulse continues beneath the city. Units near Prague are shutting down their radios to stay oriented.

sector-berlin.situation: Every abandoned radio in the ruins has begun broadcasting the same set of Alliance authentication codes.
sector-berlin.threat: A signal-eating intelligence is using the dead network to predict movement and assemble defenders from the rubble.
sector-berlin.command: Advance under emissions control, destroy the relay nests, and silence the source before it learns the full command net.
sector-berlin.victory: The false network collapsed into static. Alliance authentication is clean and the road east is open.
sector-berlin.defeat: The source escaped into the wider network. Command codes are being replaced across the theatre.

sector-warsaw.situation: A field relay assembled from civilian transmitters is coordinating the last intact eastern defense brigades.
sector-warsaw.threat: Long-range fire is walking toward the relay while armored raiders cut the streets between its antenna sites.
sector-warsaw.command: Reinforce the relay perimeter and keep at least one transmission route alive throughout the assault.
sector-warsaw.victory: The Ember Relay stayed on the air. Eastern brigades are moving as one force again.
sector-warsaw.defeat: The relay ceased transmitting during the assault. Neighboring brigades are falling back on separate routes.

sector-krakow.situation: Mirrored chambers inside the citadel are amplifying a portal tone that can be heard through concrete and armor.
sector-krakow.threat: Resonant guardians arrive in measured waves, each one strengthening the chamber that produced it.
sector-krakow.command: Break the outer harmonics, breach the citadel, and silence the central resonator.
sector-krakow.victory: The citadel mirrors are dark. Their last echo reveals the true origin of the invasion signal farther east.
sector-krakow.defeat: The choir reached full resonance. New portals are opening along the eastern approach.

sector-kyiv.situation: The eastern city command is transmitting from a shrinking defense pocket surrounded by overlapping portal fields.
sector-kyiv.threat: Enemy artillery and airborne hunters are triangulating every broadcast from the remaining command posts.
sector-kyiv.command: Break the siege geometry, reach the command pocket, and restore a protected eastbound corridor.
sector-kyiv.victory: The last broadcast became a rally signal. The eastern pocket is linked to the Alliance line.
sector-kyiv.defeat: The final command post stopped transmitting. The eastern pocket must be treated as lost.

sector-carpathian.situation: A narrow mountain route is the only ground approach that avoids the portal storms over the plains.
sector-carpathian.threat: Patrols move through concealed cuts while rock-like sentries block the switchbacks behind them.
sector-carpathian.command: Clear the pass in sequence and establish protected fuel points for the final advance.
sector-carpathian.victory: The Stone Vein is open. Heavy formations can now approach the eastern front under cover.
sector-carpathian.defeat: The pass remains blocked and the fuel column has turned back. The final advance loses its southern route.

sector-blacksea.situation: A coastal pumping station sits above a submerged breach that feeds creatures into the southern flank.
sector-blacksea.threat: The breach rises with each tide, bringing armored shapes through flooded service channels.
sector-blacksea.command: Secure the station, hold the seawall, and collapse the submerged approach before the tide peaks.
sector-blacksea.victory: The breach is buried beneath the seawall. The southern flank is quiet and the coast road is secure.
sector-blacksea.defeat: The seawall failed under pressure. Coastal units are withdrawing inland ahead of the next tide.

sector-rift.situation: All captured signal paths converge on a burning fracture where the sky and ground no longer agree.
sector-rift.threat: The breach is assembling a final guard from every defeated pattern while its warden descends through the opening.
sector-rift.command: Break the ward line, survive the converging guard, and collapse the fracture from within its perimeter.
sector-rift.victory: The Ash Crown is broken. The fracture is shrinking, hostile formations are losing cohesion, and dawn reaches the eastern line.
sector-rift.defeat: The fracture remains open and the warden holds the field. Alliance command is preparing one last defensive line in the west.
